import collections
def solve(Ig):
    H=len(Ig); W=len(Ig[0])
    vals=collections.Counter(x for r in Ig for x in r)
    bg=vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in Ig]; seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if Ig[i][j]==bg or seen[i][j]: continue
            v=Ig[i][j]; c=collections.deque([(i,j)]); seen[i][j]=True; cc=[]
            while c:
                x,y=c.popleft(); cc.append((x,y))
                for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    a,b=x+dx,y+dy
                    if 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and not seen[a][b] and Ig[a][b]==v:
                        seen[a][b]=True; c.append((a,b))
            if len(cc)==3:
                cs=set(cc)
                ctr=[p for p in cc if sum((p[0]+d[0],p[1]+d[1]) in cs for d in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)])==2][0]
                dirs=[(d[0],d[1]) for d in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)] if (ctr[0]+d[0],ctr[1]+d[1]) in cs]
                di,dj=sum(d[0] for d in dirs),sum(d[1] for d in dirs)
                di,dj=(di>0)-(di<0),(dj>0)-(dj<0)
                ii,jj=ctr[0]+2*di,ctr[1]+2*dj
                while 0<=ii<H and 0<=jj<W and out[ii][jj]==bg:
                    out[ii][jj]=v; ii+=di; jj+=dj
    return out
